provenance.why: This file was suffixed ".contaminated" when it was discovered that a timed-out `docker compose exec` had left an orphan sweep running inside the container, so two harness processes were writing this path and competing for the same API key for 53 minutes. The suffix was removed after checking what the file actually contains: 220 results over 44 unique cases at exactly 5 repeats each, and prompt_fingerprint equal to the gate 42d660fe. benchmark_ch3.py writes its json once, whole, at the end of a run, so the file is one process's complete output rather than an interleaving of two. What the duplicate sweep did corrupt is the console log (discarded) and the 403 rate: the two processes throttled each other, which is why this cell carries far more transport errors than any other. Those cases are re-run by repair_transport_errors.py, recorded in the `repairs` block below.
